execution.mode: production Chrome stream-copy conversion with independent native FFmpeg and FFprobe validation
execution.command: WITHIN_TEST_VIDEO=off npx playwright test tests/browser/media-remux.spec.ts --grep 'complex (MOV|3GP) source retains every representable field' --reporter=line
execution.nativeToolBoundary: Native FFmpeg generated the deterministic small source fixtures and independently validated outputs; every conversion under test executed through the production browser Wasm pipeline.

mov.video: 640x360 H.264, 1:1 sample aspect, 16:9 display aspect, limited-range BT.709, chroma-left, progressive, 90-degree Display Matrix, default disposition
mov.audio: two 48 kHz mono AAC tracks with eng/spa language tags and default dispositions 1/0

threeGp.video: 640x360 H.264, 1:1 sample aspect, 16:9 display aspect, limited-range BT.709, chroma-left, progressive, 90-degree Display Matrix, default disposition
threeGp.audio: two 48 kHz mono AAC tracks with eng/spa language tags and default dispositions 1/0
threeGp.generalMetadata: not representable by the generated 3GP source

sourceFields: explicit color range, space, transfer, and primaries
audio sample rate and channel count
general metadata where the source container represents it
payloads: decoded VFR video matches exactly with autorotation disabled for destinations that exclude rotation
each retained AAC access-unit stream matches exactly

matroska.payloadEquality: exact H.264 packets, decoded video, and both AAC access-unit streams

mpegTs.payloadEquality: exact H.264 packets, exact unrotated decoded video, and both AAC access-unit streams

isoBmff.payloadEquality: exact H.264 packets, decoded video, and both AAC access-unit streams

flv.payloadEquality: exact H.264 packets, exact unrotated decoded video, and first AAC access-unit stream

scope: This closes complex MOV- and 3GP-origin field/payload mappings for every currently compatible Matroska, MPEG-TS, ISO-BMFF, and FLV destination. M-03 remains partial for equally complex MPEG-TS, FLV, AVI, WebM, and Ogg origins plus attached-picture dispositions.
